Info

Defines TestSuiteConfig domain model for test generation configuration.

class gen_test.core.model.test_suite_config.TestSuiteConfig(interface_path: str, output_dir: str, include_prefix: str = '', interface_name: str | None = None, cmake_target: str | None = None, generate_mock: bool = True, generate_test: bool = True, generate_fake: bool = True, generate_cmake: bool = True, generate_main: bool = True, run_clang_format: bool = True)[source]¶

Bases: object

Configuration model controlling code synthesis options.

Parameters:

  • interface_path – Path to the input C++ interface header.

  • output_dir – Target output directory for generated files.

  • include_prefix – Optional custom include prefix, e.g. “hardware/”.

  • interface_name – Optional filter for a specific interface in file.

  • cmake_target – Optional custom CMake target name.

  • generate_mock – Whether to generate GoogleMock header.

  • generate_test – Whether to generate GoogleTest unit test file.

  • generate_fake – Whether to generate Fake stub header.

  • generate_cmake – Whether to generate CMakeLists.txt.

  • generate_main – Whether to generate test_main.cc.

  • run_clang_format – Whether to attempt formatting with clang-format.
